answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 97 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a gale bet on surviving 97 epochs of grading, and every atlas settlement recomputes the delta schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
